"""固定实现的全套检查，保留每个命令原始UTF-8字节与返回码。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-validation'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
assert head == 'e50c1d88b34fbf824cd46d1f22c2035700cc75cf'
commands = [
    ('fetch', ['cargo', 'fetch', '--locked']),
    ('build-debug', ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--locked', '--offline']),
    ('fmt', ['cargo', 'fmt', '--all', '--check']),
    ('clippy', ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings']),
    ('workspace-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline']),
    ('doc-tests', ['cargo', 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline']),
    ('resource-audit', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py']),
    ('python-tests', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v']),
    ('dependency-audit', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/audit_windows_dependencies.py', '--audit-binary',
                          r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf\.local\audit-tool\bin\cargo-audit.exe',
                          '--output', str(OUT / 'dependency-audit.json')]),
    ('build-release', ['cargo', 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline']),
]
checks = []
for name, command in commands:
    command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    raw = result.stdout
    (OUT / (name + '.raw')).write_bytes(raw)
    raw.decode('utf-8')
    checks.append({'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                   'seconds': time.perf_counter() - begin, 'output': name + '.raw',
                   'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(raw)})
    (OUT / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps({'implementation_commit': head, 'checks': checks}, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps(checks[-1]), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(raw.decode('utf-8'), flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""只运行自有工程短档、原release专项和不启动子进程的长期准入预检。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-validation'
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
assert head == 'e50c1d88b34fbf824cd46d1f22c2035700cc75cf'
records = []


def run(name, command, expected=0, child_env=None):
    command[0] = shutil.which(command[0], path=env['PATH']) or command[0]
    begin = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=child_env or env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    (OUT / (name + '.raw')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
    row = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'expected_returncode': expected,
           'seconds': time.perf_counter() - begin, 'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'),
           'sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(result.stdout)}
    records.append(row)
    (OUT / 'diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps({'implementation_commit': head, 'checks': records}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != 'stdout'}), flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == expected, row
    return result.stdout


dll = ROOT / 'target/release/cloudleaf_windows_ime.dll'
dll_identity = {'implementation_commit': head, 'dll_path': str(dll), 'bytes': dll.stat().st_size,
                'sha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(OUT / 'dll-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(dll_identity, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
for name, pattern, ignored in [
    ('real-dll-loader', 'lifecycle_review_real_dll_loader_no_registration', True),
    ('simulated-com-benchmark', 'simulated_com_diagnostic_benchmark', True),
    ('production-pressure', 'round3_cross_instance_budget_rejects_async_sync_and_candidate_before_ownership', False),
    ('recovery-fault-matrix', 'recovery::tests', False),
    ('native-round5', 'round5_', False), ('native-round4', 'round4_', False), ('native-round3', 'round3_', False),
]:
    command = ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'cloudleaf-windows-ime', '--lib', pattern, '--release', '--locked', '--offline', '--']
    if ignored:
        command.append('--ignored')
    command.extend(['--nocapture', '--test-threads=1'])
    child_env = env.copy()
    child_env['CLOUDLEAF_REVIEW_DLL'] = str(dll)
    if name == 'real-dll-loader':
        child_env['CLOUDLEAF_LIFECYCLE_REVIEW_CHILD'] = '1'
    run(name, command, child_env=child_env)
run('core-benchmark', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/benchmark.py', '--iterations', '1000', '--output', str(OUT/'core-performance.json')])
run('algorithm-regression', [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/evaluate_algorithms.py', '--output-dir', str(OUT/'algorithm-v1')])
build = run('soak-build', ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'cloudleaf-windows-ime', '--lib', '--release', '--no-run', '--message-format=json', '--locked', '--offline'])
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in build.splitlines() if line.startswith(b'{')]
binary = next(row['executable'] for row in rows if row.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
              and row.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cloudleaf_windows_ime' and row.get('executable'))
for profile in ['8h', '24h']:
    planned = OUT / ('not-started-' + profile)
    base = [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py', '--test-binary', binary,
            '--profile', profile, '--sample-seconds', '1', '--checkpoint-seconds', '60', '--output-dir', str(planned)]
    run('preflight-' + profile, base + ['--preflight-output', str(OUT / ('preflight-' + profile + '.json'))], 2)
    run('guard-' + profile, base, 2)
    assert not planned.exists()
base = [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py', '--test-binary', binary,
        '--profile', 'diagnostic', '--seconds', '4', '--cycle-ms', '50', '--sample-seconds', '.05', '--checkpoint-seconds', '.1']
for name, arguments, expected in [
    ('complete', ['--output-dir', str(OUT/'complete')], 0),
    ('interrupted', ['--output-dir', str(OUT/'resumed'), '--interrupt-after', '2.5'], 130),
    ('resumed', ['--output-dir', str(OUT/'resumed'), '--resume'], 0),
    ('injected-failure', ['--output-dir', str(OUT/'injected-failure'), '--inject-failure-cycle', '3'], 1),
]:
    run(name, base + arguments, expected)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
import stress_windows_faults as current
old_bytes = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'caefb7f:scripts/stress_windows_faults.py'], cwd=ROOT)
old_path = OUT / 'old_runner.py'
old_path.write_bytes(old_bytes)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('old_stress', old_path)
old = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(old)
original = [json.loads(line) for line in (OUT/'complete/segment-0001/events.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
mutants = []
for name in ['missing-key', 'missing-cycle', 'duplicate-sequence', 'changed-context', 'wrong-key']:
    rows = json.loads(json.dumps(original))
    positions = [i for i, row in enumerate(rows) if row.get('experiment') == 'r6-owned-key']
    if name == 'missing-key':
        rows.pop(positions[0])
    elif name == 'missing-cycle':
        rows.pop(next(i for i, row in enumerate(rows) if row.get('experiment') == 'r6-cycle'))
    else:
        row = rows[positions[1]]
        row[{'duplicate-sequence': 'sequence', 'changed-context': 'instance', 'wrong-key': 'vk'}[name]] = rows[positions[0]]['sequence'] if name == 'duplicate-sequence' else -1
    path = OUT / (name + '.jsonl')
    path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row) + '\n' for row in rows), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    before, after = old.latency_summary(path), current.latency_summary(path)
    assert not before['raw_errors'] and after['raw_errors'] and not after['trace_complete']
    mutants.append({'name': name, 'corrupted_copy_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                    'old_result': before, 'new_result': after})
(OUT/'trace-mutants.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_segment': 'complete/segment-0001',
    'scope': 'deliberately corrupted copies of owned engineering trace; not real input loss',
    'old_runner_commit': 'caefb7f2ac7c8584249c05359fcb174f87640886', 'old_runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old_bytes).hexdigest(),
    'new_commit': head, 'mutants': mutants}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print('short evidence and five actual-trace corrupted copies verified; long profiles not started', flush=True)

"""保存原始UTF-8字节、只读身份与规范Git展示件，不改历史。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEST = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl007/round7'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--', str(DEST)], cwd=ROOT)
DEST.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
from benchmark import source_sha256, environment
raw_logs, artifacts = [], []


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def export(folder, target):
    for source in sorted(folder.rglob('*')):
        if not source.is_file() or '__pycache__' in source.parts:
            continue
        output = target / source.relative_to(folder)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        data = source.read_bytes()
        text = data.decode('utf-8')
        if source.suffix in ['.txt', '.raw']:
            output = output.with_suffix('.txt')
            display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()).rstrip()
            output.write_text(display + ('\n' if display else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
            raw_path = output.with_suffix('.raw.json')
            save(raw_path, {'encoding': 'UTF-8', 'original_bytes': len(data), 'original_sha256': sha(data), 'raw_text': text})
            raw_logs.append({'original_path': str(source), 'display': output.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(),
                             'raw': raw_path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(), 'original_sha256': sha(data),
                             'published_sha256': sha(output.read_bytes())})
        else:
            normalized = data.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
            output.write_bytes(normalized)
            row = {'original_path': str(source), 'path': output.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(),
                   'original_sha256': sha(data), 'published_sha256': sha(normalized)}
            if normalized != data:
                raw_path = output.with_suffix('.original.raw.json')
                save(raw_path, {'encoding': 'UTF-8', 'original_bytes': len(data), 'original_sha256': sha(data), 'raw_text': text})
                row['original_raw'] = raw_path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix()
            artifacts.append(row)


export(ROOT / '.local/round7-validation', DEST)
export(ROOT / '.local/round7-red', DEST / 'red')
save(DEST / 'raw-logs.json', raw_logs)
save(DEST / 'raw-artifacts.json', artifacts)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()
assert head == 'e50c1d88b34fbf824cd46d1f22c2035700cc75cf'
baseline = 'caefb7f2ac7c8584249c05359fcb174f87640886'
reports = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline, 'docs/reports'], cwd=ROOT).decode().splitlines()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', *reports], cwd=ROOT)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--diff-filter=D', '--name-only', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', 'tests', 'adapters', 'crates'], cwd=ROOT)
production = ['adapters/windows', 'crates', 'apps', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', *production], cwd=ROOT)
tests = (DEST / 'workspace-tests.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
rust = sum(int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', tests))
python = re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests', (DEST / 'python-tests.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert rust == 157 and int(python[1]) == 25
manifest = json.loads((DEST / 'complete/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['identity']
assert manifest['implementation_commit'] == head
protected = {}
for name in ['data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv', 'tests/fixtures/input-v1.tsv', 'tests/evaluation/algorithm-v1.tsv']:
    path = ROOT / name
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'hash-object', '--path=' + name, str(path)], cwd=ROOT).strip() == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', baseline + ':' + name], cwd=ROOT).strip()
    protected[name] = sha(path.read_bytes())
source_paths = ['adapters/windows/' + name + '.rs' for name in ['service', 'session', 'watchdog', 'owner_cleanup', 'recovery', 'ownership', 'budget', 'candidate']]
evidence = {'implementation_commit': head, 'baseline': baseline, 'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v3',
            'source_sha256': source_sha256(), 'tool_sha256': sha((ROOT/'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py').read_bytes()),
            'test_binary_sha256': manifest['binary_sha256'], 'data_sha256': protected,
            'environment': environment(), 'run_environment': manifest['environment'],
            'source_files_sha256': {name: sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes()) for name in source_paths},
            'rust_passed': rust, 'python_passed': int(python[1]), 'default_ignored': 2,
            'historical_reports_unchanged': len(reports), 'historical_reports_changed': [], 'old_tests_deleted': [],
            'production_code_changes': [], 'long_8h_executed': False, 'long_24h_executed': False,
            'long_run_environment_approved': False, 'real_application_accepted': False,
            'system_registration_executed': False, 'system_activation_executed': False,
            'failure_identity': {'commit': None,
                'path': 'red/output.raw.json', 'summary': 'five failed semantic assertions and two missing-feature errors; not production COM failures'},
            'scope': 'offline diagnostic trace audit and explicit long-run admission; production Rust and budgets unchanged'}
# 红测完整SHA取自实际保存身份，不从缩写推造。
evidence['failure_identity']['commit'] = json.loads((DEST/'red/identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['head']
save(DEST/'evidence.json', evidence)
save(DEST/'runner-sources.json', {'sources': [{'name': name, 'sha256': sha((ROOT/'.local'/name).read_bytes()),
    'utf8': (ROOT/'.local'/name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')} for name in ['run_round7_checks.py', 'run_round7_diagnostics.py', 'export_round7_evidence.py', 'verify_round7_publication.py', 'record_round7_publication_audit.py']]})
save(DEST/'checksums.json', {'excludes_self': True, 'sha256': {path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(DEST.rglob('*')) if path.is_file() and path != DEST/'checksums.json'}})
print(json.dumps({'implementation': head, 'old_reports': len(reports), 'rust': rust, 'python': int(python[1]),
                  'published_files': len(list(DEST.rglob('*'))), 'raw_originals': len(raw_logs),
                  'source_sha256': evidence['source_sha256'], 'test_binary_sha256': manifest['binary_sha256']}))

"""核对暂存Git字节和全部原始输出，避免LF展示件冒充原件。"""
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PREFIX = 'docs/reports/cl007/round7/'


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def indexed(paths):
    request = ''.join(':' + path + '\n' for path in paths).encode('utf-8')
    stream = io.BytesIO(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT, input=request))
    result = {}
    for path in paths:
        header = stream.readline().decode().strip().split()
        assert len(header) == 3 and header[1] == 'blob', (path, header)
        result[path] = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        assert stream.read(1) == b'\n'
    assert not stream.read()
    return result


manifest = json.loads(indexed([PREFIX+'checksums.json'])[PREFIX+'checksums.json'])['sha256']
files = indexed([PREFIX + name for name in manifest])
for name, expected in manifest.items():
    assert sha(files[PREFIX+name]) == expected, name
logs = json.loads(files[PREFIX+'raw-logs.json'])
for row in logs:
    envelope = json.loads(files[PREFIX+row['raw']])
    raw = envelope['raw_text'].encode('utf-8')
    assert len(raw) == envelope['original_bytes'] and sha(raw) == envelope['original_sha256'] == row['original_sha256']
    assert Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes() == raw
    assert sha(files[PREFIX+row['display']]) == row['published_sha256']
for row in json.loads(files[PREFIX+'raw-artifacts.json']):
    raw = Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == row['original_sha256']
    assert sha(files[PREFIX+row['path']]) == row['published_sha256']
    if 'original_raw' in row:
        assert json.loads(files[PREFIX+row['original_raw']])['raw_text'].encode('utf-8') == raw
    else:
        assert files[PREFIX+row['path']] == raw
evidence = json.loads(files[PREFIX+'evidence.json'])
checks = json.loads(files[PREFIX+'checks.json'])['checks']
diagnostics = json.loads(files[PREFIX+'diagnostics.json'])['checks']
assert len(checks) == 10 and all(row['returncode'] == 0 for row in checks)
assert len(diagnostics) == 18 and all(row['returncode'] == row['expected_returncode'] for row in diagnostics)
assert sha((ROOT/'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py').read_bytes()) == evidence['tool_sha256']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', evidence['baseline'], '--', 'crates', 'apps', 'adapters/windows', 'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'], cwd=ROOT)
print(json.dumps({'git_blob_files_verified': len(manifest), 'original_utf8_logs_verified': len(logs),
                  'checks': len(checks), 'diagnostics': len(diagnostics), 'production_rust_unchanged': True}))

"""保留收尾环境准备错误，并独立捕获显式环境重跑结果。"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-validation'
command = [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py']
failure = {'scope': 'publication preparation, separate from the frozen full check run',
           'original_shell_command': 'python -X utf8 .local/verify_round7_publication.py; python -X utf8 scripts/check_workspace.py; git diff --cached --check; git diff --name-only caefb7f HEAD -- adapters/windows crates apps Cargo.toml Cargo.lock; git status --porcelain=v1 | Measure-Object -Line',
           'shell_exit_code': 0, 'individual_audit_exit_code_observed': None,
           'tool_returned_audit_text': '工程审计失败：[WinError 2] 系统找不到指定的文件。\n',
           'identity_limit': 'Original subprocess bytes were not separately captured; this records tool-returned text, not a claimed original raw byte hash.',
           'cause': 'Standalone closing shell did not prepend .cargo/bin; the full frozen checks used the explicit environment and passed.',
           'resolution': 'Do not infer success from the later shell command exit code; rerun this audit independently with explicit PATH and preserve raw output.'}
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home()/'.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(OUT/'post-publication-audit.raw').write_bytes(result.stdout)
failure['rerun'] = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                    'path_prepended': str(Path.home()/'.cargo/bin'), 'stdout_utf8': result.stdout.decode('utf-8')}
(OUT/'publication-preparation.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps(failure['rerun'], ensure_ascii=False))
assert result.returncode == 0
